versions.content: {DRAFT} In case a received PDU is extracted according to [SWS_SoAd_00559], the matching SoAdSocketRoute is disabled and the ACL check is enabled ( SoAdRxSomeIpAclCheck is TRUE ), then SoAd shall call Sd_AclPolicy- Check() to perform the ACL check.

Status: DRAFT In case a received PDU is extracted according to [SWS_SoAd_00559], the match- ing SoAdSocketRoute references a SoAdRoutingGroup which is also referenced by SdServerServiceActivationRef of SdProvidedMethods and is disabled, then SoAd shall call Sd_RequestRoutingGroupEnable(). Sd_RequestRout- ingGroupEnable() provides feedback to Sd that a Sd client tries to use a method of the server.
